title: Sprint 6 — Advanced JS & Capstone Projects
description: Solidify your skills by leveraging advanced language features and building robust, real-world applications from scratch.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — ES6+ Deep Dive
tickets.description: Elevate your code quality. You will explore advanced patterns for encapsulating logic, managing complex data streams, and organizing larger projects.

tasks.title: Task 6.1.1 — Closures & Factory Functions
tasks.description: Protect the internal state of your features to create more reliable and predictable components.

tasks.title: Task 6.1.2 — Iterators, Generators & Optional Chaining
tasks.description: Safely navigate deep data structures and manage sequenced content delivery.

tasks.title: Task 6.1.3 — Modules (import / export)
tasks.description: Organize your codebase into independent, reusable modules for better maintainability.

tasks.title: Task 6.1.4 — Error Handling & Custom Errors
tasks.description: Implement structured error handling to make debugging and user communication clearer.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — Capstone Projects
tickets.description: Put everything together. You will architect and implement comprehensive, interactive applications that solve real user needs.

tasks.title: Task 6.2.1 — Shopping Cart App
tasks.description: Develop a fully functional e-commerce shopping experience with real-time updates.
tasks.method: In-Browser DOM Assertion Engine + Synthetic Events (Method 1)

tasks.title: Task 6.2.2 — Quiz App with Timer
tasks.description: Create an engaging, time-sensitive interactive quiz application.
tasks.method: In-Browser DOM Assertion Engine + Synthetic Events (Method 1)

tasks.title: Task 6.2.3 — Weather Dashboard (Full App)
tasks.description: Construct a comprehensive dashboard that pulls, formats, and displays live external data.
tasks.method: In-Browser DOM Assertion Engine + Synthetic Events (Method 1)
